headline: IMF Cuts Argentina's Economic Growth to 2.1% and Raises Forecast Inflation for 2026 | canal26.com
summary: The IMF reduced its estimate of Argentina's economic activity to 2.1% growth and now expects average inflation of 32.5%. Its 2027 projections were also worsened.
why: The IMF's forecasts shape investor views on Argentina's growth, inflation and its ability to meet obligations under its lending programme.
